title: HitterProjectionSnapshot
description: A single checkpoint-tagged, pregame-safe hitter-prop projection produced by the Hitter Projection Checkpoint Scheduling milestone (lib.research.hitter_prospective_snapshot). Distinct from ModelEvaluation -- hitter-prop markets are NO_MODEL_SUPPORT in that schema (see model_evaluation.schema.json). Distinct from data/pipeline/<date>/hitter_projection_board.json -- that artifact is a single-file-per-date snapshot a same-day rerun silently overwrites; every row here is append-only (data/edgelab/hitter_projection_snapshots/<date>.jsonl, via lib.edgelab.storage.append_records) and is never overwritten by a later checkpoint's capture. Every field the underlying hitter_projection_board row already carries (modelProbability, executableKalshiPrice, marketTicker, marketFamily, threshold, player, playerId, distributionUsed, monteCarloStderr, sampleSizeDiagnostics, modelLimitations, projectionStatus, ...) is passed through unchanged (additionalProperties permitted for exactly this reason -- see docs/HITTER_SIMULATION_ENGINE.md Sec.4 for that row shape's own authoritative definition); this schema only formally constrains the NEW provenance/checkpoint fields this milestone adds on top.

hitterProjectionSnapshotId.description: sha1(researchRunId, marketTicker, checkpoint) -- lib.edgelab.ids.build_hitter_projection_snapshot_id. Two different checkpoints for the same ticker always produce two different, both-preserved rows.

gameId.description: MLB gamePk, resolved from the run's own pregame context. Null only if the underlying game object never carried one (never fabricated).

checkpoint.description: HITTER_CLOSING_WINDOW is deliberately distinct from lib.edgelab.prospective_snapshot.MODEL_CLOSING_WINDOW (the game-level Poisson model's own closing-window label) and from the bare 'CLOSING' label reserved for the Kalshi market's own closing quote (lib.edgelab.checkpoints.select_closing_quote) -- three different concepts, three different labels, by design.

researchRunId.description: The scheduler cycle that captured this row -- lib.edgelab.ids.new_run_id('HITTER_PROSPECTIVE_SNAPSHOT', ...).

engineCommitSha.description: The git commit SHA of this repo checkout at capture time (lib.edgelab.model_evaluation._git_commit_sha, reused unchanged -- the same provenance convention ModelEvaluation.modelCommitSha already establishes). Null only when neither GITHUB_SHA nor a local git checkout is available.

snapshotGeneratedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant this checkpoint's evaluation cycle produced this row -- distinct from projectionGeneratedAt (the underlying board row's own per-hitter simulation-completion timestamp, passed through unchanged) and from marketObservedAt (the Kalshi snapshot's own capture instant, also passed through unchanged).

sourceCapturePath.description: The exact already-committed, regularly-scheduled Kalshi snapshot file this row was priced against (data/kalshi_registry_snapshots/kalshi_search_<date>_<HHMM>.json) -- never a fresh live fetch made by this scheduler itself.
